part: Front body post mount and speedrun front splitter (End A). Own design of the owner, partly based on the T410R: the body post mount follows the original part (photos of the owner), the splitter replaces the front bumper (the car runs without the bumper).
coordinate_system: Chassis plate coordinates (assembly): x across the car (+x right side seen toward End A), y along the car (End B at y = 0, End A front), z = 0 bottom face of the chassis plate. Both parts are symmetric to x = 0; the outline points are given for the right half.
design: Body post mount: plastic part on the holes H34, H35 and H36 at the front end of the chassis plate. The rear part (deck) lies on the top face of the chassis plate; its bottom has a pocket in the form of the front end of the plate (the overhang around the plate holds the part against turning). In front of the plate the part is cranked down by the thickness of the plate, so that its bottom face is flush with the bottom face of the plate; a ramp on the top face follows the front contour of the plate. A low collar on H34 and H35 (original part: mounting points of the front bumper, here of the splitter), a round boss on H36 and an ear on each side with a boss and a hexagon recess: press fit of the body posts. Splitter: flat plate (carbon) on the mount: bottom face on the deck and on the bosses of the ears; counterbores on its bottom face fit over the collars on H34/H35, 2 countersunk screws M3 from below through the chassis plate, the mount and the splitter with nuts M3 on top; hexagon holes fit over the hexagon section of the body posts; a clearance hole for the boss on H36.

source_codes.plate: Hole pattern and outline of the speedrun chassis plate (chassis_plate_speedrun_wide_motor10_geometry.json)
source_codes.photo: Estimate from the photos of the owner (top view on a ruler, scaled to the distance H34-H35 of the chassis plate)
source_codes.assumption: Not measured, assumed for the model
source_codes.design: Design value of the own part

mount_holes.note: Holes of the chassis plate under the mount: H34/H35 (x = +-16.677, y = 317.982) under the collars (mounting points of the splitter), H36 (x = -0.114, y = 321.224) under the round boss. Photo: distance H34-H35 used as the scale, H36 found 0.5 mm from its position in the plate.

mount_rear_y.note: Straight rear edge of the mount (on the chassis plate, 3.5 behind H34/H35). The outer pivot block at End A ends at y = 309.45.

mount_outline.note: Outline of the right half from the rear corner to the centre line at the front edge (top view photo, both halves averaged). The side lip at x = 22.4 to 22.6 wraps around the side edge of the chassis plate (x = 21.33). The front edge is concave: at the centre line it lies at y = 332.55 (11.3 ahead of H36, 6.9 ahead of the front end of the plate).

pocket_clearance.note: Gap between the pocket (overhang) of the mount and the front contour of the chassis plate, all around.

deck_t.note: Thickness of the deck on the chassis plate: top face of the deck at z = 2.0 + 2.5 = 4.5. The splitter lies on it.

front_t.note: Thickness of the part in front of the chassis plate (bottom face flush with the bottom face of the plate, z = 0 to 2.5).

ramp_w.note: Width (top view) of the ramp on the top face from the deck down to the front part; it follows the front contour of the plate.

collar.note: Low collar on H34 and H35 (no hexagon, owner): outer diameter and height above the deck. Original part: mounting points of the front bumper; here: the counterbores of the splitter fit over them. Photo: diameter approx. 6.2 to 6.8, the collar reaches the rear edge; height assumed.

screw_hole_d.note: Through holes for the screws M3 (H34/H35: countersunk screws from below through the chassis plate, the mount and the splitter; ears: screws of the body posts from below).

centre_boss.note: Round boss on H36: diameter, height above the deck, bore (tap drill M3), chamfer of the top edge. It passes through a clearance hole of the splitter. Its function on the original part is not known.

ear_holes.note: Position of the holes in the ears (right ear; left ear mirrored): distance 62.3 across the car, 12.4 ahead of H34/H35. Positions of the body posts (owner).

ear_boss.note: Boss of the ears: diameter, height of its top above the bottom face (as the deck: support of the splitter), hexagon recess across flats (press fit of the body post, owner; photo approx. 7) and its depth.

body_post.note: Body posts in the ears (stock parts, assembly only): diameter, length above the top face of the splitter, bore (thread M3 of the screw from below through the ear). The hexagon section (across flats as the recess of the ear) reaches from the bottom of the recess through the hexagon hole of the splitter to its top face.

splitter_t.note: Thickness of the splitter: carbon sheet 2.0 (as the top brace and the shock towers). Bottom face on the deck of the mount (z = 4.5), top face at z = 6.5: 16.5 above the ground at the ride height of 10 (setup sheet 4).

splitter_holes.note: Holes of the splitter: diameter clearance of the counterbores over the collars (6.8 + 0.4 = 7.2), depth clearance of the counterbores (collar 1.0 + 0.1 = 1.1 deep, 0.9 material above), diameter clearance of the hole over the boss on H36 (6.0 + 1.0 = 7.0), clearance of the hexagon holes over the body posts (across flats 7.0 + 0.1).

splitter_rear_outline.note: Rear edge of the splitter, right half: vertices (x, y, fillet radius). Straight rear edge from -32 to 32 at y = 313 (1.5 behind the rear edge of the mount, 3.5 ahead of the outer pivot block); from there it runs forward around the front corners of the tyres at full steering lock and back toward the tips (see the tyre check).

splitter_overhang.note: Outer form of the splitter (owner): the lower front edge of the body (body_front_edge), offset outward by this overhang, from tip to tip; the splitter shows below the body by this distance. A larger value moves the splitter outward and gives the tips more depth.

splitter_front_radii.note: Fillet radii of the outer form at the offset points of body_front_edge, from the tip (last point) to the centre line (first point). The outer form lies at most 0.7 inside the exact offset.

body_front_edge.note: Lower front edge of the body (ZooRacing Hellcat), right half, (x, y): on the centre line approx. 68 ahead of the front axle (y = 286.9), receding toward the corners. Not measured: the overall length of the body is not published; to be measured on the car (measurement sheet B1 to B3). The outer form of the splitter follows it at the distance splitter_overhang (owner).

tyre_check.note: Check of the clearance to the front tyres: tyre width (spec_tires.yaml, setup sheet 4: 30), droop of the wheel below the static ride height (assumption), required clearance, steering angle checked in both directions (the free angle of the knuckle is approx. 30 toward the middle and 45 toward the outside; required: 25). Tyre as a cylinder of radius wheel_r on the wheel centre plane wheel_centre_x (running_gear_parameters.json).
